description: Read-only Google Analytics 4 insights through TalkToData.

interface.longDescription:
Explore the Google Analytics 4 property you selected in TalkToData through 14 read-only tools. Ask about traffic, acquisition sources, pages, devices, and a seven-day summary. The plugin fetches authorized data on demand and cannot modify your Analytics property.

TalkToData Analytics provides read-only Google Analytics 4 insights for the authenticated user's selected property. It includes summaries, traffic, sources, pages, devices, countries, cities, Realtime, landing pages, campaigns, events, ecommerce, period comparison, and Realtime breakdowns. Tool availability depends on the connected property's configuration and Google Analytics reporting data. Reports may be unavailable when access, configuration or Google reporting limits prevent retrieval. It cannot modify Google Analytics, website settings, campaigns, or tracking. TalkToData is an independent NAVINES product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google or OpenAI.

Talk with your own Google Analytics data in ChatGPT. Connect your account, select your GA4 property in TalkToData, and ask questions in everyday language. This connector retrieves reports for your selected property directly from the Google Analytics Data API. Its data source is the selected GA4 property; reports do not combine data from unrelated platforms or accounts. Analysis can refer to the metrics Google returns for that property.

Explore the available reports:
• Summary: users, sessions, views, engagement, conversions and leading pages and sources.
• Daily traffic: trends across complete reporting days.
• Traffic sources: session source and medium, users, conversions and revenue where recorded.
• Pages and landing pages: popular content, entry pages and engagement.
• Devices, countries and cities: reported audience breakdowns.
• Campaigns: sessions, users, conversions and revenue recorded against campaign names.
• Events: event counts, users and key-event activity where available.
• Ecommerce: item views, cart additions, purchases and product revenue where tracked.
• Period comparison: recent performance and the preceding period of equal length.
• Realtime and Realtime breakdowns: active-user counts over the last 30 minutes and supported country, city, page, device or event breakdowns.

Examples to try in chat:
• "What changed in my traffic compared with the previous period? Show the reported numbers."
• "Show organic-search traffic sources and, separately, my top landing pages. Suggest content questions to investigate."
• "Compare campaign conversions and revenue, then show product purchases in the ecommerce report."
• "Compare the available country and device reports for the last seven complete days."
• "How many users are active in the Realtime window, and what page or event breakdowns are available?"

You can also use these read-only GA4 reports in Codex. For example: "Use TalkToData Analytics to retrieve my top landing pages and traffic sources. Using those reports alongside the website files I provide, help me plan SEO checks and content improvements." Access to project files and any code edits depend on Codex's separate tools and permissions. The Analytics plugin itself retrieves reports.

Use the available figures as context for regular reporting, content planning and reviews of website or campaign changes. Historical reports cover complete days through yesterday in the property's reporting time zone; supported recent-period reports accept up to 90 days. Results depend on Google's processing, measurement, reporting limits and the property's tracking setup. Row limits may apply. Suggestions require interpretation and do not establish the cause of a change or predict outcomes. These GA4 reports do not provide keyword-ranking or technical site-audit data.

Explore organic-search and paid-search traffic recorded in GA4, including Google Ads-attributed visits where available. This plugin does not connect to Google Ads or Search Console, manage ads, or report keyword rankings.
capabilities: Read daily website traffic and engagement
Read session sources and acquisition reports
Read organic and paid-search traffic recorded in GA4
Read device, country and city reports
Read ecommerce product and revenue reports
Read Realtime active users and breakdowns
